title: Sales Development agent: connect to Salesforce CRM through the Salesforce MCP server
summary: The roadmap details, Salesforce setup, licensing and published Copilot Credit charges are supported. The briefing nevertheless presents organisation-wide agent blocking as a stop for autonomous work; Microsoft explicitly documents stopping work through instance blocking, not the template-level control shown here.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: The organisation-wide agent block in the controls table is a stop option for the agent's ongoing autonomous actions.
claims.quote: Searched: Sales Development Frontier copilot packages activate block agent template running instances stop; Sales Development block stop agent instances organisation. Read agent-actions, manage-agent-instances and copilotpackage-block. Only instance blocking explicitly stops ongoing actions.
claims.fix: Remove the inference 'so the controls are stopping the agent (see the controls table) and limiting the Salesforce permissions it holds' after the human-oversight quote. Replace 'Keep the stop option ready: block the agent for the organisation (second row of the controls table)' with 'Keep the organisation-wide access restriction ready: block the agent for the organisation (second row of the controls table).' The cited row documents restricting user access, not stopping running instances; https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-agent-365/admin/manage-agent-instances explicitly documents stopping through instance blocking.
